articles.headline: Daniel Dominguez wins Menards 150
articles.dek: Official finish, points and how the championship looks after the race.
articles.body:
Daniel Dominguez won Menards 150 at Kansas Speedway, starting P18 and leading 50 laps. Tyler Raheem finished second and Daniel Stavchanksy was third.

The race ran 200 laps with 9 cautions.

Tyler Raheem was the biggest mover, gaining 21 spots from P23 to P2.

Daniel Dominguez leads the championship with 3067 points, 7 ahead of Caleb Guerrier.
articles.author: Jamie Kowalski
